name: Thoughtless
source:
A dark sci-fi psychological Visual Novel where your choices shape who you are. The world has ended and it's been dominated by mysterious aliens who roam the city. Despite that, you only think of what you've lost. Will you be able to rebuild your relationships? Or even... the world itself? 

- Steam Page
translation:
一部黑暗科幻心理视觉小说，你的选择塑造了你是谁。世界已经终结，它已被在城市中漫步的神秘外星人所统治。尽管如此，你只想到你失去的东西。你能重建你们的关系吗？甚至……世界本身？

- 蒸汽页面
